story.fullStory:
Greg Kihn Band's "Jeopardy" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Jeopardy" is a song released by the Greg Kihn Band, from their 1983 album Kihnspiracy.

It was the band's only Top 10 hit on the Billboard Hot 100 singles chart, reaching number 2 in May 1983 (behind Michael Jackson's "Beat It").

It hit #1 on the Billboard Hot Club Dance Play chart in April 1983 and crossed over to the Top 50 of Billboard's Soul chart.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.
